title: Is Betelgeuse Really About to Explode?
spoken: Look at Orion this winter at the orange star on its shoulder. That star is dying. So is Betelgeuse about to explode? And what would you see if it did? It is called Betelgeuse. One day it will blow itself apart, and for a few weeks it will shine so brightly that you could see it in the daytime sky. In this film, I will show you what kind of star it is, why it scared astronomers in 2019, how a giant star actually dies, what the night it goes would look like from your garden, and the honest answer to when.
